method: Each terrain point is the heightmap index mapped through the source-backed CalcCoords of the TerrainInfo Location, TerrainScale and heightmap size (scripts/world/terrain_coordinates.py, checked equal to the serialized native ToWorld). A seam pair is the lower tile (owner) and the next tile in X or Y (neighbour); the strip width is the neighbour first point minus the owner last point on the seam axis; the facing edges are the owner last column or row and the neighbour first column or row, compared as source-unit heights.
